name: OpenAI Codex CLI
summary: OpenAI's lightweight open-source coding agent that runs in your terminal.
description: Docs moved from developers.openai.com/codex to learn.chatgpt.com. The `codex mcp-server` command and standalone `codex-mcp-server` binary were removed; integrations should migrate to the experimental Codex app server. `codex mcp` still manages external MCP servers.
